text.en:
There is hereby established under the supervision of the Ministry of Education and Culture an
agro-industrial high school in the Municipality of Lavezares, Province of Northern Samar, to be known as the
Lavezares Agro-Industrial High School.

The amount of three hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be
included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
